serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#Nun_NewOutfit.ArmL.Down
#Nun_NewOutfit.Eyes.VeryAngry+Nun_NewOutfit.Mouth.Open
Shanice: W-What is happening?! Are we under attack by the evil forces of transhumanism?! Priestcan! Bring me the rifle!
You: No, please don’t. Don’t do that.
#Nun_NewOutfit.Eyes.StaringIntoDistance+Nun_NewOutfit.Mouth.Open
Shanice: What? A rifle won’t be needed? Dang it. And here I thought I would finally be able to test it on moving targets…
You: Nun shouldn’t be saying things like that…
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceHappy
Shanice: Hehe~ Come on now. We are all sinners, nobody is perfect. Let people enjoy things.
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceSerious
You: A-Anyway. It’s an emergency! I need your help ASAP!
Shanice: This sounds very serious. Give it to me straight up. I can take it. 
#Nun_NewOutfit.Eyes.VeryAngry+Nun_NewOutfit.Mouth.Pout
You: I need a model for a fashion show. 
#Nun_NewOutfit.Eyes.VeryAngry+Nun_NewOutfit.Mouth.Ummm
Shanice: I don’t get it. Could you repeat that again?
You: One of our models didn’t come and we need a replacement! Quick! There’s not much time left!
#Nun_NewOutfit.Eyes.VeryAngry+Nun_NewOutfit.Mouth.Open
Shanice: I seriously have no idea what you are talking about. This is just too random.
You: Oh, come on! Just come with me! I will explain on our way there!
#Nun_NewOutfit.Eyes.HappyClosed+Nun_NewOutfit.Mouth.Open
Shanice: {{punch}}Wah!
